reuse.why: Puts the flag into the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that every provider's link already calls, but copies unlinkAccount's detach update instead of factoring it into a helper both share.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount detach block is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount, so 'what an unlinked account looks like' is now defined twice.

placement.why: The takeover lives in the shared guard, but a function named assert... now mutates another account as a side effect, mixing validation with the unlink operation.

scope.why: Focused on the flag and its plumbing through the six link functions, plus an unrequested 'account not found' check in the guard.

maintainability.why: One place decides the takeover, but a side-effecting assert and a copied unlink state will drift if the unlink action changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts re-implements unlinkAccount's local detach (db.updateAccount with account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status nulled) instead of sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: The detach block is an open, verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update, not disguised.
